name: Adult heightmaxxing routine

lead: An adult heightmaxxing routine is a personal program of daily habits that adults on looksmaxxing forums build in the hope of getting taller. Typical ingredients are stretching, spinal decompression, posture correction, sleep and supplements, and sometimes a method called LSJL (limb-lengthening by stress on joints).

The appearance payoff people aim for is a taller, straighter standing frame. Posture work and a decompressed spine can change measured height by small amounts across a day, while height gain from joint-loading methods is claimed by proponents and has not been shown in published trials.

paras: Posters describe nightly routines that run for months or a year, combining joint tapping or clamping, stretching, supplements such as MSM, amino acids and melatonin, and tracking height periodically.

Forum members dispute LSJL, and a critic in one thread says the idea originated on a now-defunct hobby site. Repeated loading of knees and ankles can irritate joints, and supplements carry their own cautions.

angle.text: Adults combine posture, stretching and joint-loading practices hoping to look and measure taller. The posture and spinal components affect measured height by small amounts; bone-lengthening claims for joint loading come from proponents.

lead: An adult heightmaxxing routine is a regimen assembled by adults who want more height after puberty. On looksmax.org one poster, 5'10" and aiming for 6 feet, described a planned year-long routine built around LSJL, in which joints are tapped with weights and clamped, with MSM, amino acids and melatonin added [1].

The goal is to look taller, either through gains in actual stature that proponents attribute to cartilage and bone formation at joints, or through posture and spinal decompression that restore the full standing length of the spine.

Standard references describe male growth continuing to about 18 to 19 years, with limited research suggesting minor growth after that [2]. Surgical limb lengthening is the established route to substantially more height in adults [3].
infobox: Months to a year or more

paras: The routine is not a single protocol. In the looksmax.org thread, the poster planned nightly tapping with 20 lb dumbbells on knee and ankle joints, followed by clamping for several minutes, plus MSM, amino acids and melatonin intended to boost growth hormone [1].

The poster says the idea behind LSJL is that loading joints prompts bone repair through cartilage-producing cells, which then leads to elongation like a growth plate would produce [1]. Another member replied that LSJL came from a guy named Tyler who ran the defunct site heightquest and posts on naturalheightgrowth, and wrote that it does not work [1].

Reference works describe male growth continuing to about 18 to 19 and measurement error of around 0.5 cm that can obscure small changes [2]. Measured height also varies by about 1.5 cm over a day in one paediatric study [2]. Limb lengthening by distraction osteogenesis is a surgical method with reported complications [3].

lore.intro: Height forums discuss routines combining LSJL, stretching and supplements, with active disagreement among members [1].
